defect.mechanism: The counter scanned for [A-Z][a-z]? in the string. SMILES writes aromatic nitrogen as lowercase n, so 1,10-phenanthroline (c1cnc2c(c1)ccc1cccnc12) counted zero donors. _select_ligands then dropped the fragment, and step 4 padded the empty ligand list with [OH2] until the coordination capacity (6 for every metal here) was reached. The ligand was deleted and six waters invented.
defect.fix: count_donors and _donor_score read the parsed molecule (_donor_symbols, lru_cached): N/O/S/P plus halides, excluding positively charged atoms, anionic halides, and aromatic N that carries an H (pyrrole/indole put that lone pair in the ring).

honest_limits: The donor count is still a heuristic: it counts donor ATOMS, not chelate rings, so a bidentate ligand is assumed to use all its donors.
Water padding still happens for complexes whose ligands genuinely supply fewer than 6 donors; it is now 6.7% of atoms rather than 21.2%, not zero.
Changing the counter changes every cloud in every run. Every archived CFM number was produced on the old corpus and is not comparable to a run on this one.

t61_ligand_less_rows.finding: After the T60 fix, 150 of 26,632 rows (0.56%) still reach the water-padding step because their only fragments carry no donor at all. All 150 are eta6-arene Ru half-sandwich complexes (Cc1c(C)c(C)[c-](C)c1C.Cc1ccccc1) whose donors are CARBONS, which the donor set does not represent.
t61_ligand_less_rows.fix: has_coordinating_ligand() and a rejection at the trainer boundary: build_cloud_from_csv_row returns (None, 'no_coordinating_ligand') and build_csv_cohort counts it separately from unparseable / un-embeddable / un-separable rows.
